kjv: he (God) had horns [coming] out of his hand
note: qarnayim here are rays of light (cf. Exod 34:29 Moses' face "shone"), parallel to brightness; "horns" is the literal sense that misleads.

kjv: burning coals went forth at his (God's) feet
note: resheph is plague or the plague-deity Reshep, paralleling "pestilence"; "burning coals" is a secondary sense (Song 8:6) that breaks the parallel.
